locations.note: Both the Grand Prix and Indy layouts are included, and each can also be raced in reverse.
Besides the current layout, the game offers Silverstone's 1994-2009 configuration, which brings back the old Bridge corner.
Layouts range from the oval to the Road Course, North and Sport circuits, each also raceable in reverse.
Back in the series for the first time since TOCA Race Driver 3 in 2006, raced on the Gardner GP circuit among other layouts.
Hosts the final event of Fernando Alonso's challenge ladder: a showdown with the virtual Alonso, who drives his Renault R26.
New to the series; the circuit opened in 2016 and is raced as the Full Circuit or the shorter East and West tracks.
A street course returning from the first Grid, with Grand Prix, Sprint and Short circuits and a B variant of each.
New to the series: a fictional night street track lined with neon skyscrapers, with lit tunnels and a wide-span bridge to cross.
A street circuit returning from Grid Autosport, with routes such as Columbus Bay, Fountain Loop and High Street.
New to the series; a launch trailer showed IMSA sports cars chasing Fernando Alonso here, on routes such as El Capitolio and El Malecón.
